extraction_notes: The APG077N01G is an n-channel enhancement MOSFET with VDS maximum 100 V and continuous ID rating 90 A at TA = 25 degC, p. 1.
Threshold voltage is 1.5 V minimum, 2.0 V typical, and 3.0 V maximum at VDS = VGS and ID = 250 microA, p. 2.

RDS(on) rows are 6.2 mOhm typical and 7.7 mOhm maximum at VGS = 10 V, ID = 40 A, and 8.0 mOhm typical and 10 mOhm maximum at VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 40 A, p. 2. The strict schema stores the typical resistance values; maximum values are preserved in this note.
Ciss = 3000 pF, Coss = 362 pF, and Crss = 11 pF typical at VDS = 50 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz, p. 2. The capacitance plot on p. 5 is retained as three digitized traces in SI units.
V(BR)DSS minimum is 100 V at VGS = 0 V and ID = 250 microA; the schema stores the voltage and the defining current is preserved in this note.

Body-diode forward voltage is 1.3 V maximum at VGS = 0 V and IS = 20 A, p. 2. Reverse recovery is 60 ns typical at IF = 40 A and di/dt = 100 A/us, but the strict schema has no reverse-recovery field for MOSFETs; the value is preserved in this note.

The p. 4 Fig. 3 title says Typical Output Characteristics, but its displayed axes and traces are EAS/EAS(max) versus junction temperature, not ID versus VDS; no output characteristic points were asserted from that mislabeled figure.
The transfer plot does not state VDS on the figure; the extracted curve therefore preserves VDS as unspecified rather than assigning a value.
extraction.omission_reason: No usable ID-versus-VDS output-characteristic curve is published: p. 4 Fig. 3 is mislabeled as Typical Output Characteristics but plots EAS/EAS(max) versus junction temperature. The body-diode reverse-recovery value is published but has no field in the strict schema.
